**Building the future of live entertainment** — you're not watching, you're
in it. Living worlds an audience helps shape, piloted into any place: a
venue, a live stream, a home.

Infinite Spaces is a marketplace for living worlds. Creators author participatory experiences in Playbox — worlds an audience helps shape — and run them live in venues, streams, and homes. A two-person crew produces what used to take a full production team.

The technical co-founder who owns the engineering org — the person the
Engineering Team Build-Out roles report into and
who sets the architecture across real-time, rendering, AI, and the world model.
Comes from gaming and AI: has shipped real-time systems at scale and thinks
AI-native, not AI-bolted-on.

## What You'll Do

How all seven technical layers fit into one coherent system. Where to build vs.
compose. How to run a small, high-leverage team in the agentic-development era —
people who describe systems precisely enough for AI to implement, and move
across the stack. How to get from prototype to show-scale without losing frame
rate or trust.

## What We're Looking For

- Real-time systems + game engine depth — has led engineering on games or
  live/interactive systems that shipped and held up under load
- AI-native architecture — designs systems where inference is a first-class
  participant, not a post-process
- Systems leadership — sets cross-cutting architecture, defines the contracts
  other roles build against, hires and grows a polymath team
- Founder temperament — comfortable with pre-seed risk, equity-heavy structure,
  and building the org while building the product

## Benefits

- Competitive Seattle salary and meaningful early equity
- Equity-heavy structures available before cash is fully in place, with an honest timeline to when salary normalizes
- Health, dental, and vision coverage
- A small team where everyone owns real surface area and your work ships

*You're not watching. You're in it.*
